contracts.text: When happyDOM.close() is called while a Request body read is in progress, the read must reject with a DOMException named AbortError.
contracts.adverse_condition: A Request body read is in flight (started but not yet resolved) at the moment happyDOM.close() is invoked.

contracts.text: When page.close() is called while a Request body read is in progress, the read must reject with a DOMException named AbortError.
contracts.adverse_condition: A Request body read is in flight (started but not yet resolved) at the moment page.close() is invoked.

contracts.text: When browser.close() is called while a Request body read is in progress, the read must reject with a DOMException named AbortError.
contracts.adverse_condition: A Request body read is in flight (started but not yet resolved) at the moment browser.close() is invoked.

contracts.text: When a navigation swaps out the active page state while a Request body read is in progress, the read must reject with a DOMException named AbortError.
contracts.adverse_condition: A Request body read is in flight (started but not yet resolved) at the moment navigation discards the active page state.

contracts.adverse_condition: A Response body read is in flight (started but not yet resolved) at the moment happyDOM.close() is invoked.

contracts.adverse_condition: A Response body read is in flight (started but not yet resolved) at the moment browser.close() is invoked.

contracts.text: When a navigation swaps out the active page state while a Response body read is in progress, the read must reject with a DOMException named AbortError.
contracts.adverse_condition: A Response body read is in flight (started but not yet resolved) at the moment navigation discards the active page state.

contracts.text: When any of the four shutdown triggers (happyDOM.close, page.close, browser.close, or navigation that swaps page state) occurs while multipart formData() parsing is in progress, the parsing must reject with a DOMException named AbortError.
contracts.adverse_condition: Multipart formData() parsing is in flight (started but not yet resolved) at the moment the shutdown trigger fires.

contracts.text: The rejected error object must be an instance of DOMException (not a plain Error, TypeError, or other built-in error type).
The DOMException's name property must be exactly the string "AbortError".
Successful Request/Response body reads that are not interrupted by shutdown must remain unchanged in behavior and return value.
A fully buffered Response body (one whose entire body was already read into memory before shutdown) must remain readable after shutdown and must not reject.
contracts.adverse_condition: The Response body was fully buffered (completely consumed and held in memory) before any shutdown trigger fires.

contracts.text: Scheduled timers (setTimeout/setInterval) that are associated with page state discarded by any of the four shutdown triggers must be cleared and must not fire.
contracts.adverse_condition: Timers were scheduled on a page before that page state was discarded via close or navigation.

contracts.text: requestAnimationFrame callbacks that are associated with page state discarded by any of the four shutdown triggers must be cleared and must not fire.
contracts.adverse_condition: requestAnimationFrame callbacks were registered on a page before that page state was discarded via close or navigation.

contracts.text: All work must be performed on a new branch created from main.
All changes must be committed when the work is complete.
